summary: Iteration 34: Tested Invoice PDF Preview/Print/Download and Device Remote Viewer Badge features. All 10 backend tests pass (100%). Frontend UI verified with 5 screenshots showing all features working correctly.

issues: PDF iframe content appears dark/blue initially - PDF rendering works but may take a moment to display content. This is expected browser behavior for embedded PDFs.

critical_code_review_comments: Console warnings for DialogContent missing 'Description' or 'aria-describedby' - accessibility enhancement suggestion
Chart width/height warnings from recharts library on dashboard - minor, doesn't affect functionality
seed_data_creation: None needed - used existing invoice (INV-20260312-7760) and device (dev-001 AGENT-TEST)
context_for_next_testing_agent: All 3 requested features are working: 1) Invoice PDF Preview dialog opens from both detail view 'Preview PDF' button and list view Print icon button, includes Print and Download buttons with iframe PDF display. 2) Invoice list has Print (printer icon) and Download (download icon) buttons per row. 3) Device Remote Viewer Badge appears on AGENT-TEST (dev-001) in both table and grid views showing '1 tech: Alex Thompson' with cyan shimmer styling. Backend uses in-memory store for active viewers (reset on server restart).

invoice_pdf_preview.notes: Dialog opens with Print/Download buttons, iframe displays PDF content

invoice_list_print_download.notes: Print button (data-testid=print-btn-{id}) opens PDF preview dialog, Download button (data-testid=download-btn-{id}) triggers PDF download

invoice_pdf_download.notes: Preview returns inline content-disposition, download returns attachment content-disposition with invoice number filename

device_remote_viewer_badge_table.notes: Badge with data-testid=remote-viewer-badge-{id} shows viewer count and names with cyan shimmer styling

device_remote_viewer_badge_grid.notes: Card shows '1 tech remoted in: Alex Thompson' with cyan border and eye icon indicator

device_viewer_api.notes: In-memory viewer tracking works correctly. Viewers persist until stopped or server restart.

TestInvoicePDF: test_invoice_pdf_preview - GET /api/invoices/{id}/pdf returns PDF with inline disposition
test_invoice_pdf_download - GET /api/invoices/{id}/pdf/download returns PDF with attachment disposition
TestDeviceRemoteViewers: test_start_remote_viewing - POST /devices/{id}/start-remote-viewing adds user as viewer
test_verify_viewer_in_active_list - viewer appears in active-remote-viewers after starting
test_verify_viewer_removed_after_stop - viewer count decreases after stopping
